title: ExceptionDesk / CaseProof — Evidence, Coverage and Promotion Contract
compatibility: v1 remains unchanged; no v2 endpoint may be enabled before typed schema, authorization, and contract tests pass

security.rule: Resolve tenant ownership and reviewer authorization in application boundary on every read/write. Requests may carry expected version selectors as preconditions; server validates against the effective policy.
security.cross_tenant: Deny access without leaking evidence, identifiers, errors, or metadata across tenants

SourceVersion.identity: Immutable tenant-scoped source bytes. Digest verifies captured bytes, not provenance authenticity.

derived_representation.semantics: New OCR/parser/normalizer output receives new ID; old representations remain immutable while retained. No silent anchor remapping.

text_span.rules: kind=text_span; start/end strict nonnegative integers, 0-based Unicode code-point half-open; end>start; encoding=utf-8; normalization=none|NFC|NFD|NFKC|NFKD; basis=unicode_codepoint_zero_based_half_open

pdf_region.rules: kind=pdf_region; x0/y0/x1/y1/page_width/page_height are canonical bounded decimal JSON STRINGS, never numbers/floats/exponents; page_index 0-based int; rotation 0|90|180|270; basis=pdf_points_unrotated_bottom_left; region within page bounds

sheet_range.rules: kind=sheet_range; sheet_id identifies the versioned workbook sheet; A1 uppercase range; table_id explicit nullable optional identifier; basis=spreadsheet_a1_sheet_id

structured_field.rules: kind=structured_field; path is nonempty JSON array of nonempty string keys or nonnegative integer indices; basis=json_path_v1

EvidenceAnchor.invalidation: Stale, missing, cross-tenant or unresolved anchors fail closed. Re-OCR/reparse requires a new anchor and support assessment; no fuzzy fallback resolution.
EvidenceAnchor.wire_authority: KRN-102 typed locators via to_kernel_locator + exact storage codec; no live v2 routes

FindingCandidate.notes: Candidates may be unanchored only in quarantine; lifecycle status cannot be set directly by a client.

FindingEvidenceLink.note: Each assessment addresses this exact statement revision. Link-level sufficiency differs from aggregated policy-level sufficiency; faithful quotation never establishes truth.

CoverageManifest.completion: Computed for frozen scope/manifest/policy; processed alone is never complete. Missing required evidence, unresolved contradictions and unauthorized exclusions fail ordinary completion.

PromotionRequest.behavior: Optimistic revision comparison, trusted policy, evidence and coverage aggregation, reviewer authorization and immutable audit. Every approval freezes statement/source/representation/assessment/manifest/policy revisions.
PromotionRequest.idempotency: Same key and identical fingerprint returns prior response; same key and different fingerprint conflicts.

BusinessExceptionDisposition.rule: Policy-authorized operational risk acceptance; separate from finding verification or approved conclusion. Underlying contradiction, insufficiency and unresolved gaps stay visible.

promotion_policy_default.candidate_to_evidence_grounded: At least one tenant-authorized resolved anchor with matched fidelity and recorded semantic assessment against statement revision; does not imply factual truth.
promotion_policy_default.evidence_grounded_to_review_ready: All relied-on links resolvable and fidelity acceptable; coverage packet frozen with explicit unresolved or qualified issues disclosed.
promotion_policy_default.review_ready_to_approved_conclusion: Explicit authorized human approval, complete ordinary coverage, support + policy-level sufficiency for each material finding, no unresolved material contradiction/qualification/unknown; all revisions frozen.
promotion_policy_default.conflicting_evidence: Do not majority-vote away contradictions. Revise/qualify statement and reassess, or keep unresolved; business exception does not approve conclusion.

proposed_routes.POST /v2/evidence-anchors: Resolve/record typed anchor (tenant derived; reject unsupported locator).
proposed_routes.GET /v2/cases/{id}/coverage: Return issue-to-source manifest and policy outcome.
proposed_routes.POST /v2/cases/{id}/promotion: Evaluate guarded transition and record human decision/audit.
proposed_routes.POST /v2/cases/{id}/exception-dispositio: Record policy-authorized business risk acceptance separately.

errors.409: stale optimistic revision, idempotency-key conflict, invalid transition, incomplete coverage or unresolved evidence gate
errors.422: malformed input or unsupported typed locator

stage_gates.stage1: In-memory domain invariants and adversarial tests; no claim of durable multi-tenant persistence.
stage_gates.stage2: Actual tenant authorization, atomic durable state+audit, recovery and replay tests.
stage_gates.krn109: Generate/enforce formal OpenAPI/JSON Schemas and payload, error, authorization, transition compatibility tests before enabling v2.
